title: Framed Concentric Windows
description: An aged, weathered wooden frame contains three distinct rectangular window-like structures against a dark teal background. The central structure consists of multiple nested concentric square frames creating a tunnel effect, while the left and right structures show vertical rectangular openings with broken, peeling surfaces and visible decay.
prompt: A heavily weathered and aged wooden frame containing three distinct window-like structures on a dark teal background. The center features multiple nested concentric square wooden frames creating a tunnel effect, while the left and right sides show vertical rectangular openings with broken slats. The entire piece shows extreme texture with peeling paint, cracks, chips, and accumulated grime on the surfaces.
medium: wood, paint, and plaster on canvas
